title: The thread
logline: Monday. A thread about the strip on someone else's board. Forty replies. The chorus reads them aloud in a round. Wood draws the round as a wave of balloons and doesn't letter one of them.

panels.composition: The garage. The CRT: a thread, forty replies, scrolling. WOOD. The chorus, twelve, reading.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a man at a CRT showing a long forum thread while twelve stick figures at the back read it aloud, a small dog

panels.composition: The chorus's balloons: forty, overlapping, a wave across the panel. None lettered. The shape of talk.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a panel filled with forty overlapping empty speech balloons rising from a row of stick figures like a wave, no words
image.notes: Forty balloons, all empty. The strip doesn't letter strangers' words.

panels.composition: Wood, under the wave, drawing the dog.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a man drawing a small dog on a pad beneath a mass of empty speech balloons

panels.composition: The wave receding. Twelve figures. One balloon left, small, lettered — the only one: 'the dog tho.'

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, twelve stick figures with a single small speech balloon remaining among them
image.notes: The one lettered balloon: 'the dog tho.'

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: Forty balloons, one lettered. 'the dog tho.'
